A. Ring palette: go green. The light grey-beige canvas disappears against a light concrete floor and swallows the white ropes. A mid-green canvas, kept bright rather than forest-dark so it stays inside the house rule, makes the ropes, red and blue pads and skin tones read at once. It's also the look the operator liked.
Canvas #2f7a52
Apron top #256340
Skirt #1b4a30
Posts #2b2f36
Ropes #f4f1e8
Hairline #d4af37
Pad, red corner (A) #c8372f
Pad, blue corner (B) #2d63b8
Pad, neutral 1 #ecebe6
Pad, neutral 2 #ecebe6 Bench seats take their corner's pad hex, with a #23262b frame.
B. The surround for a club bout. All low poly, flat colour. Distances are from the platform edge, and the platform is 0.9 m high.
Floor: box 22×18×0.2, centred on the ring, #cfc6b4.
Walls: back and left only, 4.5 m tall, 8 m out, lower 1.2 m brick #9a4b3a, upper plaster #d9c3a0. The camera side and right side stay open.
Ringside barrier: two cylinder rails at 0.6 m and 1.1 m high on posts every 1.5 m, 1.5 m out, #8d949c. It runs on all four sides.
Floor chairs: boxes 0.45×0.45×0.85, three rows with 0.9 m pitch, first row 2.4 m out, on the left and back sides, #2c4a7a.
Bleachers: three wooden tiers, each 0.4 m high and 0.9 m deep, 8 m long, on the left, 5.5 m out, #7a5232.
Judges' table: box 4.0×0.8×0.75 with a cloth, 1.8 m out on the right side, #f2efe6. Add three chairs #23262b and three flat scoring boxes 0.3×0.2×0.03 #8d949c.
Timekeeper table and bell: table 1.2×0.6×0.75 #4a3524, 1.2 m from a neutral corner, with a cylinder bell r 0.08 × 0.12 m high #e0b030.
Banners: three boxes 1.0×3.0×0.03 on the back wall, 1.5 m apart. They are red #c8372f, blue #2d63b8 and gold #e0b030, with a 0.5 m cream #f4f1e8 stripe at the base. No text or logos.
Spectators: capsules 0.4 m wide × 1.7 m tall, standing behind the barrier and on the bleachers. About 40, instanced, in six muted colours: #b5523f #3e6a8a #d6b25a #6b7d5a #8d6e9a #cfc8b8.
Pendant lamps: four cylinders r 0.35 × 0.25 m high, 4.2 m up over the ring, #23262b, with a warm emissive underside.
Doorway and red runner: a door cut 1.4×2.4 m in the back wall, with a 1.2×6 m carpet from it to the barrier, #b0302a.
Heavy bags: two cylinders r 0.18 × 1.0 m high on thin chains, at the back left, 0.5 m apart, #8a5a34.
C. Light. Only the key casts shadows.
Key: warm, 4200 K, from 35° left of the camera axis and 55° up, full strength, soft shadows. It's the sun through the left window.
Fill: cool, 6500 K, from the opposite side at 25° up, 30% of key strength, no shadows.
Rim: gold, 3200 K, from behind the ring (180° from camera) at 30° up, 50% strength, no shadows. It separates the fighters from the canvas.
Pendant lamps: 2700 K point lights, no shadows, giving warm pools on the canvas.
The void: it becomes the room, with the walls and concrete floor above. Edges darken gently with a vignette of at most 25%, and no pixel falls below about #6e6358. It never goes dark or empty.
D. Concept image below. It's a mood and layout reference. The hex values above win where they differ. The render shows three ropes and dark neutral posts, but we keep four paper-white ropes and the posts and neutral pads from A.
